---
title: "Carbon data for Canada"
subtitle: "Explore ground observations, environmental covariates and maps for Canadian forests and soils. See what the data contain, how they compare, and where to access them. GEE tools for using the data are planned."
aliases:
  - state_of_data_summary/state_of_data_summary.html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
source(file.path("report", "_setup.R"))
G <- cat_tbl("Ground_data"); M <- cat_tbl("Maps"); S <- cat_tbl("Studies"); A <- cat_tbl("Assets")
O <- cat_tbl("Other_sources"); C <- cat_tbl("Covariates"); L <- cat_tbl("Study_ground")
xw <- crosswalk |> select(record_id, domain, data_type, ecosystem)
period <- S |> select(study_id, temporal_context)
dom_label <- c(forests = "Forests", soils = "Soils", both = "Forests and soils")
access_label <- function(status) c(Hosted = "Project GEE", `External asset` = "Public GEE")[status] %|% "Provider"
```

::: {.lede}
Coverage is strongest for forest biomass and terrestrial soils; regional coastal, wetland and other resources are included where documented. This is not an exhaustive inventory of every Canadian carbon dataset.
:::

```{r}
#| results: asis
st <- function(id) comp_stats[comp_stats$id == id, ]
mcm <- read_pair_samples("mcm_forest") |> filter(a > 0, b > 0)
ssg <- read_pair_samples("sothe_sg")
hz <- ssg |> filter(ecozone == "Hudson Plain") |> summarise(a = median(a), b = median(b))
cat(sprintf(
"::: {.callout-tip appearance=\"simple\"}
**What the comparisons show** ([details](compare.qmd))

- **McMaster/WWF forest carbon vs SCANFI:** McMaster/WWF (above + below + dead) is a median %.2f× SCANFI aboveground carbon, and the two share their spatial pattern (r = %.2f). The pools differ, so they are not expected to match.
- **Sothe (McMaster/WWF) vs SoilGrids, 0–100 cm:** the two soil stock maps are close to uncorrelated (r = %.2f), with the largest gap in the peat-rich Hudson Plain (median %.0f vs %.0f kg C/m²), where SoilGrids excludes overlying organic layers.
- **Peat thickness:** Li et al. and PEATGRIDS agree within ±25%% at %s of sampled Hudson Plain points, but their whole-column carbon does not.
:::
", median(mcm$a / mcm$b), st("mcm_scanfi_c")$pearson_r, st("sothe_sg_0_100")$pearson_r, hz$a, hz$b,
   percent(st("peat_depth")$within_25pct, 1)))
```

## Find a dataset {#find}

Search, or filter by ecosystem, data type, quantity, coverage or access. "Not hosted by this project" never means unavailable: follow the access link to the provider.

```{r}
#| label: find-table
#| column: page
find <- bind_rows(
  G |> transmute(record_id = ground_id, Name = resource_name, Quantity = carbon_pool_or_measurement, Coverage = geographic_coverage,
                 Support = observation_support, `Depth / pool` = depth_support, url = source_url,
                 Access = ifelse(record_status == "Hosted", "Project GEE; provider", access_route)),
  M |> transmute(record_id = map_id, Name = product_name, Quantity = paste0(carbon_pool_or_quantity, " (", source_units_and_scaling, ")"),
                 Coverage = geographic_coverage, Support = ifelse(is.na(reported_output_grid_m), "–", paste(reported_output_grid_m, "m grid")),
                 `Depth / pool` = depth_support, url = source_url, Access = access_label(record_status)),
  O |> transmute(record_id = other_source_id, Name = resource_name, Quantity = depth_or_pool, Coverage = geographic_context,
                 Support = spatial_support, `Depth / pool` = depth_or_pool, url = source_url, Access = access_status)
) |>
  left_join(xw, by = "record_id") |>
  transmute(Name = ifelse(is.na(url), htmlEscape(Name), sprintf("<a href='%s' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>%s</a>", url, htmlEscape(Name))),
            `Forests / soils` = dom_label[domain], `Data type` = tools::toTitleCase(data_type), Ecosystem = ecosystem,
            Quantity, Coverage, Support, `Depth / pool`, Access)
DT::datatable(find, escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", class = "compact stripe",
              options = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = FALSE, dom = "ftip", scrollX = TRUE))
```

# Forests {#forests}

## Ground data {#forests-ground}

Forest plot and tree datasets for Canada. None is hosted by this project yet; each is available from its provider, sometimes on request.

```{r}
fg <- G |> filter(in_domain(ground_id, "forests"))
roles <- L |> left_join(S |> select(study_id, study_name), by = "study_id") |>
  group_by(ground_id) |> summarise(roles = paste0(study_name, " (", study_role, ")", collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")
fg |> transmute(Dataset = resource_name, Measures = carbon_pool_or_measurement, Coverage = geographic_coverage,
                `Plot support` = na_dash(observation_support), Access = link_md(source_url, na_dash(access_route)),
                `Use and limitations` = first_sentence(considerations)) |>
  kable()
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple"}
## Details: study roles and licences

```{r}
fg |> left_join(roles, by = "ground_id") |>
  transmute(Dataset = resource_name, `Used by (role)` = na_dash(roles), Licence = na_dash(licence_note), `Catalogue status` = record_status) |> kable()
```
:::

## Covariates {#forests-covariates}

Environmentally correlated variables (reflectance, radar, canopy structure, climate, terrain) that forest studies used to map biomass and carbon. Entry counts are not predictor importance.

```{r}
cov_summary <- function(ids) {
  C |> filter(study_id %in% ids) |>
    group_by(study_id) |>
    summarise(Families = paste(sort(unique(family)), collapse = ", "),
              grids = list(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(native_grid_m))),
              Periods = paste(head(unique(na.omit(temporal_window)), 3), collapse = "; "),
              `Evidence recorded` = paste(names(sort(table(evidence_level), decreasing = TRUE)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(`Source grids (m)` = vapply(grids, function(g) if (all(is.na(g))) "–" else paste(fmt_n(min(g, na.rm = TRUE)), "–", fmt_n(max(g, na.rm = TRUE))), "")) |>
    left_join(S |> select(study_id, study_name, output_grid_m), by = "study_id") |>
    transmute(Study = coalesce(study_name, study_id), `Output grid (m)` = na_dash(output_grid_m), Families, `Source grids (m)`,
              Periods = na_dash(Periods), `Evidence recorded`)
}
cov_summary(S$study_id[in_domain(S$study_id, "forests")]) |> kable()
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple"}

## Maps {#forests-maps}

```{r}
map_records <- function(dom) {
  M |> filter(in_domain(map_id, dom)) |> left_join(period, by = "study_id") |>
    transmute(map_id, Product = product_name, Quantity = paste0(carbon_pool_or_quantity, " (", source_units_and_scaling, ")"),
              Coverage = geographic_coverage, `Grid (m)` = na_dash(reported_output_grid_m), `Depth / pool` = depth_support,
              Period = na_dash(temporal_context), Access = link_md(source_url, access_label(record_status)),
              `Use and limitations` = first_sentence(considerations))
}
map_records("forests") |> select(-map_id) |> kable()
```

```{r}
preview_html(c("forest_carbon", "scanfi_biomass", "esa_cci_2020"))
```

# Soils {#soils}

## Ground data {#soils-ground}

Five soil profile and core datasets are prepared and hosted by this project; more are catalogued from their providers. **`r fmt_n(sum(profile_summary$profiles))` profile records, of which `r fmt_n(sum(profile_summary$outside_canada_ecozones))` lie outside Canada's terrestrial ecozones (mostly Pacific coast cores); records are not deduplicated across datasets.**

```{r}
profile_summary |>
  transmute(Dataset = dataset, `Profiles / layers` = paste(fmt_n(profiles), "/", fmt_n(layers)),
            Dates = ifelse(is.na(year_min), "Not recorded", paste0(year_min, "–", year_max, " (", fmt_n(profiles_dated), " dated)")),
            `Recorded depth` = paste0("median ", fmt_n(median_deepest_layer_cm), " cm; ", percent(share_reaching_100cm, 1), " reach 1 m"),
            `SOC / density / stock in layers` = paste(percent(layers_with_soc, 1), ifelse(is.na(layers_with_bd), "not used", percent(layers_with_bd, 1)),
                                                       ifelse(is.na(layers_with_stock_value), "–", percent(layers_with_stock_value, 1)), sep = " / "),
            `Depth datum` = depth_datum, Qualifiers = qualifiers) |>
  kable(caption = "Share of layer rows with a value; values may be measured or estimated (see qualifiers).")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-profile-map
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Profile locations by dataset (EPSG:3978). Janousek also extends along the US and Mexican Pacific coast, outside this frame."
locs <- read_csv(file.path(derived, "profile_locations.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, dataset_levels))
pts <- locs |> filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) |> st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(3978)
bb <- st_bbox(ecozones)
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ecozones, fill = "#eef0ea", colour = "#c9cdc4", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = pts, aes(colour = dataset), size = 0.35, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dataset_cols) + facet_wrap(~dataset, ncol = 3) +
  coord_sf(xlim = bb[c(1, 3)], ylim = bb[c(2, 4)], datum = NA) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank())
```

```{r}
G |> filter(in_domain(ground_id, "soils"), record_status != "Hosted") |>
  transmute(Dataset = resource_name, Measures = carbon_pool_or_measurement, Coverage = geographic_coverage,
            `Sites / profiles` = na_dash(profile_or_site_count), `Depth support` = na_dash(depth_support),
            Access = link_md(source_url, na_dash(access_route))) |>
  kable(caption = "Further soil observation datasets, available from their providers (not hosted by this project).")
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple"}
## Details: profiles by ecozone

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.6
counts <- locs |> filter(!is.na(ecozone)) |> count(ecozone, dataset)
ord <- counts |> group_by(ecozone) |> summarise(n = sum(n)) |> arrange(n) |> pull(ecozone)
ggplot(counts, aes(dataset, factor(ecozone, ord), fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1) + geom_text(aes(label = fmt_n(n), colour = n > 600), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = pal$seq, trans = "log10", guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = pal$ink), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```
:::

## Covariates {#soils-covariates}

Environmentally correlated variables that soil and peat studies used: climate, terrain, vegetation, reflectance, geology and depth.

```{r}
cov_summary(S$study_id[in_domain(S$study_id, "soils")]) |> kable()
```

## Maps {#soils-maps}

Grouped by what they represent. Concentration, density, fixed-depth stocks and full-column peat stocks are different quantities.

```{r}
#| results: asis
sm <- map_records("soils") |> left_join(M |> select(map_id, carbon_pool_or_quantity, depth_support_raw = depth_support), by = "map_id") |>
  mutate(Group = case_when(
    grepl("peat", paste(Product, carbon_pool_or_quantity), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Full-column peat",
    grepl("polygon|landscape", paste(Product, carbon_pool_or_quantity, depth_support_raw), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Landscape polygons",
    grepl("stock", carbon_pool_or_quantity, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Fixed-depth stock",
    TRUE ~ "Concentration and density"))
for (g in c("Fixed-depth stock", "Concentration and density", "Full-column peat", "Landscape polygons")) {
  t <- sm |> filter(Group == g) |> select(Product, Quantity, Coverage, `Grid (m)`, `Depth / pool`, Period, Access, `Use and limitations`)
  if (nrow(t)) { cat("\n\n**", g, "**\n\n::: {.cell-output-display}\n\n", sep = ""); print(kable(t)); cat("\n\n:::\n\n") }
}
```

```{r}
preview_html(c("sothe_stock", "soilgrids_ocs", "geng_soc_0_5", "ncscd_100", "peatgrids_stock", "li_peat_carbon", "li_peat_depth"))
```
